principal.description:
Kerberos principal. Typical format is primary/instance@REALM. (ie. hive/_HOST/PRINCIPAL.COM)
Should also provide either keytabFilePath, keytabContent, or password. First available value for one of
`keytabFilePath, keytabContent, or password` will be used in the same order.

keytabContent.description:
The user's keytab content that contains encrypted user name and password. As the file is in binary format,
the content needs to be base64 encoded for this field. In Kerberos world, you can login using a principal name
and the password, or, a keytab file that's generated from the principal and the password.

keytabFilePath.description: The user's keytab content file that contains encrypted user name and password.

title:
This holds credential fields for Kerberos authentication. This type can be a field of a C3 credentials type such as
{@link ApacheCredentials}, {@link JdbcCredentials}.
name: KerberosCredentials
